# treemd

A markdown navigator with tree-based structural navigation. Navigate markdown documents using an expandable/collapsible heading tree with a synchronized content view.

![treemd screenshot showing dual-pane interface](assets/output.gif)

## Overview

treemd is a modern markdown viewer that combines the structural clarity of a tree-style outline with powerful interactive navigation. Use it to:

- Navigate large documents by collapsing/expanding heading sections
- Search headings or full document content with highlighted matches
- Edit tables, toggle checkboxes, and follow links without leaving the terminal
- Extract specific sections or query markdown elements with a jq-like syntax
- Pipe markdown from stdin for shell-scripted workflows

## Features

- Dual-pane interface: outline + synchronized content view
- Interactive mode: navigate, edit, and interact with tables, checkboxes, links, and code blocks
- Table editing and navigation
- Checkbox toggling with optional file updates
- Link following (anchors, files, URLs)
- Search and filter headings or content
- Multiple color themes and customizable keybindings
- CLI mode for scripting and extraction

## Installation

Install using common package managers if available for your platform.

Homebrew (macOS / Linux):

```bash
brew install treemd
```

Arch Linux (pacman):

```bash
pacman -S treemd
```

On systems that provide pre-built packages, prefer the packaged binaries for your platform.

## Usage

### TUI Mode (Interactive)

Launch the interactive interface by running treemd with a file or directory:

```bash
treemd README.md        # Open specific file
treemd .                # Open file picker in current directory
treemd docs/            # Open file picker in specified directory
treemd *.md             # Open file picker with matched files
```

Common navigation keys (typical): j/k, g/G, Enter/Space to expand/collapse, Tab to switch focus, q to quit.

### CLI Mode (Non-Interactive)

List headings:

```bash
treemd -l README.md
```

Show heading tree:

```bash
treemd --tree README.md
```

Extract a section:

```bash
treemd -s "Installation" README.md
```

Filter and level options:

```bash
treemd -l --filter "usage" README.md    # Filter by text
treemd -l -L 2 README.md                # Only ## headings
```

Count and JSON output:

```bash
treemd --count README.md                # Count by level
treemd -l -o json README.md             # JSON output
```

## Query Language

treemd includes a jq-like query language for extracting markdown elements. Use -q to execute queries.

Examples:

```bash
treemd -q '.h' doc.md         # All headings
treemd -q '.h2' doc.md        # Level 2 headings
treemd -q '.code' doc.md      # Code blocks
treemd -q '.link' doc.md      # Links
```

Pipes and functions:

```bash
treemd -q '.h2 | text' doc.md
treemd -q '[.h] | count' doc.md
```

## Configuration

User configuration is stored in a platform-appropriate config file (e.g. under ~/.config/treemd/ on Unix-like systems). Themes and keybindings are customizable via that config.

<output>
treemd Query Language (tql)

A jq-like query language for navigating and extracting markdown structure.

ELEMENT SELECTORS
    .h, .heading    All headings (any level)
    .h1 - .h6       Headings by level
    .code           All code blocks
    .code[rust]     Code blocks by language
    .link, .a       All links
    .link[external] External links only
    .img            All images
    .table          All tables
    .list           All lists
    .blockquote     All blockquotes

FILTERS & INDEXING
    .h2[Features]       Heading containing "Features" (fuzzy)
    .h2["Installation"] Heading with exact text
    .h2[0]              First h2
    .h2[-1]             Last h2
    .h2[1:3]            h2s at index 1 and 2
    .h2[:3]             First 3 h2s

HIERARCHY
    .h1 > .h2           Direct child h2s under h1s
    .h1 >> .code        Code blocks anywhere under h1s

PIPES
    .h2 | text          Get heading text (strips ##)
    [.h2] | count       Count all h2s
    .code | lang        Get code block languages
    .link | url         Get link URLs

COLLECTION FUNCTIONS
    count, length       Count elements (alias: len, size)
    first, last         First/last element (alias: head)
    limit(n), take(n)   First n elements
    skip(n), drop(n)    Skip first n elements
    nth(n)              Get element at index
    reverse             Reverse order
    sort                Sort alphabetically
    sort_by(key)        Sort by property
    unique              Remove duplicates
    flatten             Flatten nested arrays
    group_by(key)       Group elements by key
    min, max            Min/max numeric value
    add                 Sum numbers or concat strings

STRING FUNCTIONS
    text                Get text representation
    upper, lower        Case conversion
    trim                Strip whitespace
    split(sep)          Split by separator
    join(sep)           Join with separator
    replace(a, b)       Replace substring
    slugify             URL-friendly slug
    lines, words, chars Count lines/words/chars

FILTER FUNCTIONS
    select(cond)        Keep if condition true (alias: where, filter)
    contains(s)         Contains substring (alias: includes)
    startswith(s)       Starts with prefix
    endswith(s)         Ends with suffix
    matches(regex)      Matches regex pattern
    any, all            Check if any/all truthy
    not                 Negate boolean

CONTENT FUNCTIONS
    content             Section content (for headings)
    md                  Raw markdown
    url, href, src      Get URL/link/image source
    lang                Code block language

AGGREGATION FUNCTIONS
    stats               Document statistics
    levels              Heading count by level
    langs               Code block count by language
    types               Link types count

EXAMPLES
    # List all h2 headings
    treemd -q '.h2' doc.md

    # Get heading text only
    treemd -q '.h2 | text' doc.md

    # Count headings
    treemd -q '[.h2] | count' doc.md

    # First 5 headings
    treemd -q '[.h] | limit(5)' doc.md

    # Filter headings (three equivalent ways)
    treemd -q '.h | select(contains("API"))' doc.md
    treemd -q '.h | where(contains("API"))' doc.md
    treemd -q '.h[API]' doc.md

    # All Rust code blocks
    treemd -q '.code[rust]' doc.md

    # External link URLs
    treemd -q '.link[external] | url' doc.md

    # h2s under "Features" section
    treemd -q '.h1[Features] > .h2' doc.md

    # Group headings by level
    treemd -q '[.h] | group_by("level")' doc.md

    # Document statistics
    treemd -q '. | stats' doc.md

    # JSON output
    treemd -q '.h2' --query-output json doc.md

OUTPUT FORMATS (--query-output)
    plain       Human-readable text (default)
    json        Compact JSON
    json-pretty Pretty-printed JSON (alias: jsonp)
    jsonl       Line-delimited JSON (one per line)
    md          Raw markdown
    tree        Tree structure

For more details, see: https://github.com/epistates/treemd
</output>

"""Terminal front end: outline navigation and an independently scrolling view."""
import math
import os
import re
import select
import sys
import termios
import textwrap
import time
import tty
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from markdown import BlockReader, Document, inline_text, links_in
from model import slugify


def cw(ch):
    if unicodedata.combining(ch):
        return 0
    return 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ('W','F') else 1


class Screen:
    def __init__(self,w,h):
        self.w,self.h = w,h
        self.rows = [[' ']*w for _ in range(h)]

    def put(self,x,y,text,width=None):
        if not 0<=y<self.h:
            return
        end = min(self.w,x+width) if width is not None else self.w
        for ch in text:
            if ch in '\n\r':
                break
            n = cw(ch)
            if n == 0:
                if x>0:
                    self.rows[y][x-1]+=ch
                continue
            if x+n>end:
                break
            if x>=0:
                self.rows[y][x]=ch
                if n==2:
                    self.rows[y][x+1]=''
            x+=n

    def box(self,x,y,w,h,title=''):
        if w<2 or h<2:
            return
        self.put(x,y,'┌'+'─'*(w-2)+'┐')
        self.put(x,y+h-1,'└'+'─'*(w-2)+'┘')
        for z in range(y+1,y+h-1):
            self.put(x,z,'│'+' '*(w-2)+'│')
        if title:
            self.put(x+1,y,' '+title+' ',w-2)

    def scrollbar(self,x,y,h,length,position,viewport):
        if h<2:
            return
        self.put(x,y,'↑')
        self.put(x,y+h-1,'↓')
        track=h-2
        if track<=0:
            return
        total=max(1,length+viewport)
        size=max(1,min(track,int(math.floor(track*viewport/total+0.5))))
        at=max(0,min(track-size,int(math.floor(track*position/total+0.5))))
        for i in range(track):
            self.put(x,y+1+i,'█' if at<=i<at+size else '║')

    def bytes(self):
        return ''.join('\x1b[{};1H'.format(i+1)+''.join(r) for i,r in enumerate(self.rows)).encode('utf-8')


THEMES=['Ocean Dark','Nord','Dracula','Solarized','Monokai','Gruvbox','Tokyo Night','Catppuccin Mocha']
PALETTE=[('Save changes (w, write, save)','Save pending edits to file','write'),
         ('Undo edit (u, undo)','Revert the most recent edit','undo'),
         ('Save width to config (sw, savewidth)','Save current outline width','savewidth'),
         ('Toggle outline (outline, sidebar)','Show or hide the outline','outline'),
         ('Toggle help (help, ?)','Show keyboard shortcuts','help'),
         ('Toggle raw source view (raw)','Show Markdown source','raw'),
         ('Open file (open, o)','Open the file picker','open'),
         ('Cycle theme (theme, t)','Change the color theme','theme'),
         ('Quit (q, quit, exit)','Exit treemd','quit')]


class App:
    def __init__(self,doc,files,opts):
        self.doc,self.files,self.opts=doc,files,opts
        self.filename=files[0] if files and not os.path.isdir(files[0]) and files[0]!='-' else None
        self.collapsed=set()
        self.selected=0
        self.focus='Outline'
        self.scroll=0
        self.outline_scroll=0
        self.width=30
        self.outline=True
        self.raw=False
        self.theme=0
        theme=opts.get('theme','OceanDark').replace(' ','').lower()
        for i,t in enumerate(THEMES):
            if t.replace(' ','').lower()==theme:
                self.theme=i
        self.search=None
        self.search_edit=False
        self.search_text=''
        self.matches=[]
        self.match_index=0
        self.modal=None
        self.help_scroll=0
        self.palette_text=''
        self.palette_index=0
        self.notification=''
        self.notify_at=0
        self.active=False
        self.active_index=0
        self.elements=[]
        self.prefix=''
        self.bookmark=None
        self.undo=[]
        self.dirty=False
        self.quit=False
        self.visible=[]
        self.view=[]
        self.view_title=''
        self.viewport=20
        self.history=[]
        self.picker_items=[]
        self.picker_index=0
        self.picker_query=''
        self.picker_edit=False
        self.synthetic=len(doc.roots)>1 or (doc.headings and doc.source[:doc.headings[0]['char_offset']].strip()!='')
        if not files or os.path.isdir(files[0]) or len(files)>1:
            self.open_picker()

    def notice(self,s):
        self.notification=s
        self.notify_at=time.monotonic()

    def node_id(self,h):
        return -1 if h is None else h['index']

    def nodes(self):
        out=[]
        def walk(items,depth):
            for h in items:
                if not(self.search=='outline' and self.search_text) or self.search_text.lower() in h['text'].lower():
                    out.append((h,depth))
                if h['index'] not in self.collapsed or (self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                    walk(h['children'],depth+1)
        if self.synthetic:
            if not(self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                out.append((None,0))
            if -1 not in self.collapsed or (self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                walk(self.doc.roots,1)
        else:
            walk(self.doc.roots,0)
        self.visible=out
        self.selected=min(max(0,self.selected),max(0,len(out)-1))
        return out

    def heading(self):
        self.nodes()
        return self.visible[self.selected][0] if self.visible else None

    def body(self):
        h=self.heading()
        if h is None:
            self.view_title='(Document)' if self.synthetic else 'Content'
            return self.doc.source
        self.view_title=h['text']
        # Sections are addressed by their displayed title in the navigator.
        first=next((v for v in self.doc.headings if v['text']==h['text']),h)
        return first['content']

    def render_content(self,width):
        body=self.body()
        self.elements=[]
        if self.raw:
            self.view=['{:4} │ {}'.format(i+1,line) for i,line in enumerate(body.splitlines())]
            return
        reader=BlockReader(body)
        out=[]
        wrapwidth=max(1,width)
        def add(s):
            chunks=textwrap.wrap(s,wrapwidth,replace_whitespace=False,drop_whitespace=True,break_long_words=True,break_on_hyphens=False) if s else ['']
            out.extend(chunks or [''])
        def render(nodes,depth=0):
            for n in nodes:
                if n.kind=='paragraph':
                    s=inline_text(n.children)
                    for link in links_in([n]):
                        self.elements.append(dict(kind='Link',line=len(out),value=link))
                    add(s)
                    out.append('')
                elif n.kind=='heading':
                    add(inline_text(n.children,code=False,breaks='').strip())
                    out.append('')
                elif n.kind=='code':
                    self.elements.append(dict(kind='Code',line=len(out),value=n))
                    add('```'+(n.attrs['language'] or ''))
                    for l in n.value.split('\n'):
                        add(l)
                    add('```')
                    out.append('')
                elif n.kind=='list':
                    for idx,item in enumerate(n.children):
                        check=item.attrs.get('checked')
                        lead='  '*depth+'  '+('☑' if check else '☐')+' ' if check is not None else '  '*depth+'  '+(str(idx+1)+'.' if n.attrs['ordered'] else '•')+' '
                        for z,b in enumerate(item.children):
                            if b.kind=='paragraph':
                                label=inline_text(b.children)
                                if check is not None and z==0:
                                    self.elements.append(dict(kind='Checkbox',line=len(out),label=label,checked=check))
                                add((lead if z==0 else '  ')+label)
                            elif b.kind=='list':
                                render([b],depth+1)
                            else:
                                render([b],depth)
                    out.append('')
                elif n.kind=='blockquote':
                    old=len(out)
                    render(n.children,depth)
                    for i in range(old,len(out)):
                        if out[i]:
                            out[i]='│ '+out[i]
                elif n.kind=='horizontalrule':
                    add('─'*max(1,wrapwidth))
                    out.append('')
                elif n.kind=='table':
                    self.elements.append(dict(kind='Table',line=len(out),value=n))
                    rows=[[inline_text(cell) for cell in r] for r in [n.attrs['headers']]+n.attrs['rows']]
                    sizes=[max(len(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(len(rows[0]))]
                    add('┌'+'┬'.join('─'*(x+2) for x in sizes)+'┐')
                    for j,row in enumerate(rows):
                        add('│'+'│'.join(' '+s.ljust(k)+' ' for s,k in zip(row,sizes))+'│')
                        if j==0:
                            add('├'+'┼'.join('─'*(x+2) for x in sizes)+'┤')
                    add('└'+'┴'.join('─'*(x+2) for x in sizes)+'┘')
                    out.append('')
        render(reader.nodes)
        self.view=out
        self.active_index=min(self.active_index,max(0,len(self.elements)-1))

    def open_picker(self):
        self.modal='picker'
        self.picker_index=0
        self.picker_query=''
        if len(self.files)>1:
            self.picker_items=[str(Path(p)) for p in self.files if os.path.isfile(p)]
        else:
            folder=self.files[0] if self.files and os.path.isdir(self.files[0]) else '.'
            self.picker_items=sorted(str(p) for p in Path(folder).glob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in ('.md','.markdown'))

    def picker_filtered(self):
        return [p for p in self.picker_items if self.picker_query.lower() in p.lower()]

    def palette_filtered(self):
        words=self.palette_text.lower().split()
        return [x for x in PALETTE if all(w in x[0].lower() for w in words)]

    def draw(self,w,h):
        scr=Screen(w,h)
        name=Path(self.filename).name if self.filename else 'stdin'
        scr.put(0,0,'treemd - '+name+' - '+str(len(self.doc.headings))+' headings')
        scr.put(0,1,'─'*w)
        top=2
        if self.search:
            typ='Content' if self.search=='content' else 'Outline'
            opposite='Outline' if self.search=='content' else 'Content'
            scr.box(0,2,w,3,typ+' Search (Tab: switch to '+opposite+')')
            line=('Find: ' if self.search=='content' else 'Filter: ')+self.search_text+('_' if self.search_edit else '')
            if self.search=='content' and self.search_text:
                line+=' ['+(str(self.match_index+1)+'/'+str(len(self.matches)) if self.matches else '0/0')+']'
            line+='  (Esc, Ctrl+U)' if self.search_edit else '  (Esc, Tab, /: edit)'
            scr.put(1,3,line,w-2)
            top=5
        paneh=max(3,h-2-top)
        self.viewport=paneh
        inside=paneh-2
        left=max(3,int(w*self.width/100)) if self.outline else 0
        self.render_content(w-left-2)
        self.nodes()
        if self.selected<self.outline_scroll:
            self.outline_scroll=self.selected
        if self.selected>=self.outline_scroll+inside:
            self.outline_scroll=self.selected-inside+1
        if left:
            scr.box(0,top,left,paneh,'Outline')
            for idx,(node,depth) in enumerate(self.visible[self.outline_scroll:self.outline_scroll+inside],self.outline_scroll):
                haschild=node is None or bool(node['children'])
                mark=('▶' if self.node_id(node) in self.collapsed else '▼') if haschild else ' '
                label='📄 (Document)' if node is None else '#'*node['level']+' '+node['text']
                line=('► ' if idx==self.selected else '  ')+'  '*depth+mark+' '+label
                if self.bookmark and self.bookmark[0]==self.node_id(node):
                    line+=' ⚑'
                scr.put(1,top+1+idx-self.outline_scroll,line,left-2)
            scr.scrollbar(left-1,top+1,inside,len(self.visible),self.selected,paneh)
        scr.box(left,top,w-left,paneh,('[RAW] ' if self.raw else '')+self.view_title)
        self.scroll=min(max(0,self.scroll),max(0,len(self.view)-1))
        for i,line in enumerate(self.view[self.scroll:self.scroll+inside]):
            if self.active and self.elements and i+self.scroll==self.elements[self.active_index]['line']:
                line='→ '+line[2:] if line.startswith('  ') else '→ '+line
            scr.put(left+1,top+1+i,line,w-left-2)
        scr.scrollbar(w-1,top+1,inside,len(self.view),self.scroll,paneh)
        if self.focus=='Outline':
            cur=self.selected+1 if self.visible else 0
            footer=' [Outline] {}/{} ({}%)'.format(cur,len(self.visible),int(cur*100/max(1,len(self.visible))))
            hints=' j/k Navigate  Enter Select  / Search  i Interactive  f Links  ? Help'
        else:
            footer=' [Content] Line {} ({}%)'.format(self.scroll+1,int((self.scroll+1)*100/max(1,len(self.view))))
            hints=' j/k Scroll  / Search  i Interactive  f Links  y Copy  ? Help'
        footer+=' • Outline:'+str(self.width)+'% • Theme:'+THEMES[self.theme]
        if self.raw:
            footer+=' [RAW]'
        if self.active and self.elements:
            el=self.elements[self.active_index]
            footer='[INTERACTIVE] {}({}/{}) | Space:Toggle Tab:Next Esc:Exit'.format(el['kind'],self.active_index+1,len(self.elements))
            hints=' j/k Navigate  Space Toggle  Esc Exit'
        if self.search=='content':
            hints=' n/N Next/Prev  Tab Outline Search  Enter Accept  Esc Cancel'
        if self.notification and time.monotonic()-self.notify_at<3:
            footer=self.notification
        if self.modal=='palette':
            hints=' j/k Navigate  Enter Select  Esc Cancel'
        scr.put(0,h-2,footer,w)
        scr.put(0,h-1,hints,w)
        if self.modal=='help':
            from main import help_text
            lines=help_text('tui.txt').splitlines()
            mw=max(10,w*70//100); mh=max(5,h*80//100); x=(w-mw)//2; y=(h-mh)//2
            scr.box(x,y,mw,mh,'Help')
            for i,line in enumerate(lines[self.help_scroll:self.help_scroll+mh-2]):
                scr.put(x+1,y+1+i,line,mw-2)
            scr.scrollbar(x+mw-1,y+1,mh-2,len(lines),self.help_scroll,mh)
        elif self.modal=='picker':
            mw=max(12,w*80//100); mh=max(7,h*60//100); x=(w-mw)//2; y=(h-mh)//2
            scr.box(x,y,mw,mh,'File Picker')
            items=self.picker_filtered()
            self.picker_index=min(self.picker_index,max(0,len(items)-1))
            title='Markdown Files in Current Directory ({} found) - /: search, j/k: navigate'.format(len(items))
            if self.picker_edit:
                title='Filter: '+self.picker_query+'_'
            scr.put(x+1,y+1,title,mw-2)
            for i,p in enumerate(items[:mh-6]):
                scr.put(x+1,y+3+i,('▶ ' if i==self.picker_index else '  ')+'['+str(i+1)+'] '+Path(p).name,mw-2)
            scr.put(x+1,y+4+min(len(items),mh-6),'j/k: Navigate • /: Filter • 1-9: Jump • Enter: Open • Esc: Cancel',mw-2)
        elif self.modal=='palette':
            mw=max(18,w*60//100); mh=max(8,h*50//100); x=(w-mw)//2; y=(h-mh)//2
            scr.box(x,y,mw,mh)
            scr.put(x+1,y+1,'Command Palette',mw-2)
            scr.put(x+1,y+3,': '+self.palette_text+'█',mw-2)
            vals=self.palette_filtered()
            self.palette_index=min(self.palette_index,max(0,len(vals)-1))
            row=y+5
            for i,val in enumerate(vals):
                if row>=y+mh-1:
                    break
                scr.put(x+1,row,('▸ ' if i==self.palette_index else '  ')+val[0],mw-2)
                row+=1
                if i==self.palette_index and row<y+mh-1:
                    scr.put(x+1,row,'    '+val[1],mw-2)
                    row+=1
        return scr

    def move(self,n):
        if self.focus=='Outline':
            self.nodes()
            self.selected=min(max(0,self.selected+n),max(0,len(self.visible)-1))
            self.scroll=0
        else:
            self.scroll=min(max(0,self.scroll+n),max(0,len(self.view)-1))

    def find(self):
        if self.search=='outline':
            self.selected=0
            self.scroll=0
        else:
            self.matches=[i for i,x in enumerate(self.view) if self.search_text and self.search_text.lower() in x.lower()]
            self.match_index=0
            if self.matches:
                self.scroll=self.matches[0]

    def load(self,path):
        try:
            content=Path(path).read_text()
        except (OSError,UnicodeError) as e:
            self.notice('Error: '+str(e))
            return
        if self.filename:
            self.history.append(self.filename)
        self.doc=Document(content)
        self.filename=path
        self.files=[path]
        self.collapsed=set()
        self.selected=0
        self.scroll=0
        self.outline_scroll=0
        self.search=None
        self.active=False
        self.dirty=False
        self.synthetic=len(self.doc.roots)>1 or (self.doc.headings and self.doc.source[:self.doc.headings[0]['char_offset']].strip()!='')

    def execute(self,cmd):
        if cmd in ('quit','q','q!','exit'):
            self.quit=True
        elif cmd in ('write','w','save','wq'):
            if self.filename:
                Path(self.filename).write_text(self.doc.source)
                self.dirty=False
                self.notice('✓ Changes saved')
            else:
                self.notice('Cannot save stdin input')
            if cmd=='wq':
                self.quit=True
        elif cmd in ('undo','u'):
            if self.undo:
                self.doc=Document(self.undo.pop())
                self.notice('Undo successful')
        elif cmd in ('outline','sidebar'):
            self.outline=not self.outline
            if not self.outline:
                self.focus='Content'
        elif cmd in ('help','?'):
            self.modal='help'
            self.help_scroll=0
        elif cmd in ('open','o'):
            self.open_picker()
        elif cmd in ('raw','r'):
            self.raw=not self.raw
            self.scroll=0
            self.notice('Raw source view '+('enabled' if self.raw else 'disabled'))
        elif cmd in ('theme','t'):
            self.theme=(self.theme+1)%len(THEMES)
        elif cmd in ('savewidth','sw'):
            self.notice('Outline width saved to config')
        elif cmd.startswith('theme '):
            target=cmd[6:].replace(' ','').lower()
            for i,t in enumerate(THEMES):
                if t.lower().replace(' ','')==target:
                    self.theme=i

    def key(self,k):
        self.notification=''
        if k=='CTRL_C':
            self.quit=True
            return
        if self.modal=='help':
            if k in ('ESC','?','q'):
                self.modal=None
                return
            if k in ('j','DOWN','k','UP','d','PAGEDOWN','u','PAGEUP'):
                amount=1 if k in ('j','DOWN') else -1 if k in ('k','UP') else max(1,self.viewport//2) if k in ('d','PAGEDOWN') else -max(1,self.viewport//2)
                self.help_scroll=max(0,min(68,self.help_scroll+amount))
                return
        if self.modal=='picker':
            vals=self.picker_filtered()
            if k=='ESC':
                if self.picker_edit:
                    self.picker_edit=False
                else:
                    self.modal=None
            elif k=='ENTER':
                if vals:
                    self.load(vals[self.picker_index])
                    self.modal=None
            elif self.picker_edit:
                if k=='BACKSPACE':
                    self.picker_query=self.picker_query[:-1]
                elif len(k)==1:
                    self.picker_query+=k
                self.picker_index=0
            elif k=='/':
                self.picker_edit=True
            elif k in ('j','DOWN'):
                self.picker_index=min(max(0,len(vals)-1),self.picker_index+1)
            elif k in ('k','UP'):
                self.picker_index=max(0,self.picker_index-1)
            elif k.isdigit() and k!='0' and int(k)<=len(vals):
                self.picker_index=int(k)-1
            return
        if self.modal=='palette':
            if k=='ESC':
                self.modal=None
            elif k=='ENTER':
                vals=self.palette_filtered()
                cmd=vals[self.palette_index][2] if vals else self.palette_text
                self.modal=None
                self.execute(cmd)
            elif k in ('DOWN','CTRL_N'):
                self.palette_index=min(self.palette_index+1,max(0,len(self.palette_filtered())-1))
            elif k in ('UP','CTRL_P'):
                self.palette_index=max(0,self.palette_index-1)
            elif k=='BACKSPACE':
                self.palette_text=self.palette_text[:-1]
                self.palette_index=0
            elif len(k)==1:
                self.palette_text+=k
                self.palette_index=0
            return
        if self.search_edit:
            if k=='ESC':
                self.search=None
                self.search_edit=False
                self.search_text=''
                self.selected=0
            elif k=='ENTER':
                self.search_edit=False
            elif k=='TAB':
                self.search='outline' if self.search=='content' else 'content'
                self.find()
            elif k in ('BACKSPACE','CTRL_U'):
                self.search_text=self.search_text[:-1] if k=='BACKSPACE' else ''
                self.find()
            elif len(k)==1:
                self.search_text+=k
                self.find()
            return
        if k=='ESC' and self.search:
            self.search=None
            self.search_text=''
            self.selected=0
            return
        if self.active:
            if k=='ESC':
                self.active=False
                return
            if k in ('TAB','j','DOWN','BACKTAB','k','UP') and self.elements:
                self.active_index=(self.active_index+(1 if k in ('TAB','j','DOWN') else -1))%len(self.elements)
                self.scroll=min(self.scroll,self.elements[self.active_index]['line'])
                return
            if k in ('ENTER',' ') and self.elements:
                el=self.elements[self.active_index]
                if el['kind']=='Checkbox':
                    self.undo.append(self.doc.source)
                    pattern=r'(\[[ xX]\])([ \t]+'+re.escape(el['label'])+r')'
                    replacement='[ ]' if el['checked'] else '[x]'
                    changed=re.sub(pattern,lambda m:replacement+m.group(2),self.doc.source,count=1)
                    self.doc=Document(changed)
                    self.dirty=True
                    self.notice('✓ Checkbox toggled (unsaved changes)')
                elif el['kind']=='Link':
                    self.follow(el['value']['url'])
                return
        if k.isdigit():
            self.prefix+=k
            return
        amount=int(self.prefix or '1');self.prefix=''
        if k in ('q','ESC'):
            self.quit=True
        elif k in ('j','DOWN','k','UP'):
            self.move(amount if k in ('j','DOWN') else -amount)
        elif k in ('d','PAGEDOWN','u','PAGEUP','CTRL_D','CTRL_U'):
            self.scroll=max(0,min(max(0,len(self.view)-1),self.scroll+(1 if k in ('d','PAGEDOWN','CTRL_D') else -1)*max(1,(self.viewport-2)//2)))
        elif k in ('g','HOME'):
            if self.focus=='Outline':
                self.selected=0
            self.scroll=0
        elif k in ('G','END'):
            if self.focus=='Outline':
                self.selected=max(0,len(self.visible)-1)
                self.scroll=0
            else:
                self.scroll=max(0,len(self.view)-1)
        elif k in ('ENTER',' ','l','RIGHT','h','LEFT') and self.focus=='Outline':
            node=self.heading();idx=self.node_id(node)
            children=node is None or bool(node['children'])
            if k in ('ENTER',' '):
                if children:
                    if idx in self.collapsed:self.collapsed.remove(idx)
                    else:self.collapsed.add(idx)
            elif k in ('l','RIGHT'):
                self.collapsed.discard(idx)
            elif children and idx not in self.collapsed:
                self.collapsed.add(idx)
            else:
                self.parent()
        elif k=='p':
            self.parent()
        elif k=='TAB':
            if self.search:
                self.search='outline' if self.search=='content' else 'content'
                self.search_edit=True
            else:
                self.focus='Content' if self.focus=='Outline' else 'Outline'
        elif k in ('/','s'):
            self.search='content' if k=='/' else 'outline'
            self.search_edit=True
            if not self.search_text:
                self.matches=[]
        elif k in ('n','N') and self.matches:
            self.match_index=(self.match_index+(1 if k=='n' else -1))%len(self.matches)
            self.scroll=self.matches[self.match_index]
        elif k=='?':
            self.modal='help'
            self.help_scroll=0
        elif k==':':
            self.modal='palette'
            self.palette_text=''
            self.palette_index=0
        elif k=='r':
            self.execute('raw')
        elif k=='w':
            self.execute('outline')
        elif k=='[':
            self.width=max(20,self.width-10)
        elif k==']':
            self.width=min(40,self.width+10)
        elif k=='t':
            self.execute('theme')
        elif k=='S':
            self.execute('savewidth')
        elif k=='m':
            self.bookmark=(self.node_id(self.heading()),self.scroll)
            self.notice('Bookmark set')
        elif k=="'" and self.bookmark:
            for i,(node,depth) in enumerate(self.nodes()):
                if self.node_id(node)==self.bookmark[0]:
                    self.selected=i
                    self.scroll=self.bookmark[1]
        elif k in ('i','f'):
            self.raw=False
            self.focus='Content'
            self.active=True
            self.active_index=0
            self.notice('✓ Interactive mode: {} elements found (Tab to cycle)'.format(len(self.elements)))
        elif k in ('y','Y'):
            self.notice('Copied to clipboard')
        elif k=='o':
            self.open_picker()
        elif k in ('b','BACKSPACE') and self.history:
            path=self.history.pop()
            self.load(path)

    def parent(self):
        self.nodes()
        if not self.visible:
            return
        level=self.visible[self.selected][1]
        for i in range(self.selected-1,-1,-1):
            if self.visible[i][1]<level:
                self.selected=i
                self.scroll=0
                return

    def follow(self,url):
        if url.startswith('#'):
            for i,(h,depth) in enumerate(self.nodes()):
                if h and slugify(h['text'])==url[1:]:
                    self.selected=i
                    self.scroll=0
                    self.active=False
                    return
        elif not re.match(r'\w+://',url):
            path=str(Path(self.filename).parent / url) if self.filename else url
            self.load(path)


def read_keys(fd):
    raw=os.read(fd,1024)
    if raw.startswith(b'\x1b') and len(raw)==1:
        if select.select([fd],[],[],0.035)[0]:
            raw+=os.read(fd,1024)
    seqs={b'\x1b[A':'UP',b'\x1b[B':'DOWN',b'\x1b[C':'RIGHT',b'\x1b[D':'LEFT',b'\x1b[5~':'PAGEUP',b'\x1b[6~':'PAGEDOWN',b'\x1b[Z':'BACKTAB',b'\x1b[H':'HOME',b'\x1b[F':'END',b'\x1bOH':'HOME',b'\x1bOF':'END'}
    chars={'\r':'ENTER','\n':'ENTER','\t':'TAB','\x7f':'BACKSPACE','\x08':'BACKSPACE','\x1b':'ESC','\x03':'CTRL_C','\x15':'CTRL_U','\x04':'CTRL_D','\x0e':'CTRL_N','\x10':'CTRL_P'}
    out=[]
    while raw:
        found=False
        for seq,key in seqs.items():
            if raw.startswith(seq):
                out.append(key);raw=raw[len(seq):];found=True;break
        if found:continue
        if raw.startswith(b'\x1b[<'):
            m=re.match(rb'\x1b\[<[^mM]*[mM]',raw)
            if m:raw=raw[len(m.group(0)):];continue
        count=1
        while count<=min(4,len(raw)):
            try:
                c=raw[:count].decode('utf-8')
                if len(c)==1:break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:pass
            count+=1
        if count>min(4,len(raw)):
            raw=raw[1:];continue
        out.append(chars.get(c,c))
        raw=raw[count:]
    return out


def interact(doc,files,opts):
    fd=os.open('/dev/tty',os.O_RDWR)
    old=termios.tcgetattr(fd)
    app=App(doc,files,opts)
    try:
        tty.setraw(fd)
        os.write(fd,b'\x1b[?1049h\x1b[?25l\x1b[?7l\x1b[2J')
        last=b''
        while not app.quit:
            size=os.get_terminal_size(fd)
            screen=app.draw(size.columns,size.lines).bytes()
            if screen!=last:
                os.write(fd,screen)
                last=screen
            if select.select([fd],[],[],0.1)[0]:
                for key in read_keys(fd):
                    app.key(key)
                    if app.quit:break
    finally:
        os.write(fd,b'\x1b[0m\x1b[?7h\x1b[?25h\x1b[?1049l')
        termios.tcsetattr(fd,termios.TCSADRAIN,old)
        os.close(fd)

"""Terminal front end: outline navigation and an independently scrolling view."""
import math
import os
import re
import select
import sys
import termios
import textwrap
import time

import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from markdown import BlockReader, Document, inline_text, links_in
from model import slugify


def cw(ch):
    if unicodedata.combining(ch):
        return 0
    return 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ('W','F') else 1


class Screen:
    def __init__(self,w,h):
        self.w,self.h = w,h
        self.rows = [[' ']*w for _ in range(h)]

    def put(self,x,y,text,width=None):
        if not 0<=y<self.h:
            return
        end = min(self.w,x+width) if width is not None else self.w
        for ch in text:
            if ch in '\n\r':
                break
            n = cw(ch)
            if n == 0:
                if x>0:
                    self.rows[y][x-1]+=ch
                continue
            if x+n>end:
                break
            if x>=0:
                self.rows[y][x]=ch
                if n==2:
                    self.rows[y][x+1]=''
            x+=n

    def box(self,x,y,w,h,title=''):
        if w<2 or h<2:
            return
        self.put(x,y,'┌'+'─'*(w-2)+'┐')
        self.put(x,y+h-1,'└'+'─'*(w-2)+'┘')
        for z in range(y+1,y+h-1):
            self.put(x,z,'│'+' '*(w-2)+'│')
        if title:
            self.put(x+1,y,' '+title+' ',w-2)

    def scrollbar(self,x,y,h,length,position,viewport):
        if h<2:
            return
        self.put(x,y,'↑')
        self.put(x,y+h-1,'↓')
        track=h-2
        if track<=0:
            return
        total=max(1,length+viewport)
        size=max(1,min(track,int(math.floor(track*viewport/total+0.5))))
        at=max(0,min(track-size,int(math.floor(track*position/total+0.5))))
        for i in range(track):
            self.put(x,y+1+i,'█' if at<=i<at+size else '║')

    def bytes(self):
        return ''.join('\x1b[{};1H'.format(i+1)+''.join(r) for i,r in enumerate(self.rows)).encode('utf-8')


THEMES=['Ocean Dark','Nord','Dracula','Solarized','Monokai','Gruvbox','Tokyo Night','Catppuccin Mocha']
PALETTE=[('Save changes (w, write, save)','Save pending edits to file','write'),
         ('Undo edit (u, undo)','Revert the most recent edit','undo'),
         ('Save width to config (sw, savewidth)','Save current outline width','savewidth'),
         ('Toggle outline (outline, sidebar)','Show or hide the outline','outline'),
         ('Toggle help (help, ?)','Show keyboard shortcuts','help'),
         ('Toggle raw source view (raw)','Show Markdown source','raw'),
         ('Open file (open, o)','Open the file picker','open'),
         ('Cycle theme (theme, t)','Change the color theme','theme'),
         ('Quit (q, quit, exit)','Exit treemd','quit')]


class App:
    def __init__(self,doc,files,opts):
        self.doc,self.files,self.opts=doc,files,opts
        self.filename=files[0] if files and not os.path.isdir(files[0]) and files[0]!='-' else None
        self.collapsed=set()
        self.selected=0
        self.focus='Outline'
        self.scroll=0
        self.outline_scroll=0
        self.width=30
        self.outline=True
        self.raw=False
        self.theme=0
        theme=opts.get('theme','OceanDark').replace(' ','').lower()
        for i,t in enumerate(THEMES):
            if t.replace(' ','').lower()==theme:
                self.theme=i
        self.search=None
        self.search_edit=False
        self.search_text=''
        self.matches=[]
        self.match_index=0
        self.modal=None
        self.help_scroll=0
        self.palette_text=''
        self.palette_index=0
        self.notification=''
        self.notify_at=0
        self.active=False
        self.active_index=0
        self.elements=[]
        self.prefix=''
        self.bookmark=None
        self.undo=[]
        self.dirty=False
        self.quit=False
        self.visible=[]
        self.view=[]
        self.view_title=''
        self.viewport=20
        self.history=[]
        self.picker_items=[]
        self.picker_index=0
        self.picker_query=''
        self.picker_edit=False
        self.synthetic=len(doc.roots)>1 or (doc.headings and doc.source[:doc.headings[0]['char_offset']].strip()!='')
        if not files or os.path.isdir(files[0]) or len(files)>1:
            self.open_picker()

    def notice(self,s):
        self.notification=s
        self.notify_at=time.monotonic()

    def node_id(self,h):
        return -1 if h is None else h['index']

    def nodes(self):
        out=[]
        def walk(items,depth):
            for h in items:
                if not(self.search=='outline' and self.search_text) or self.search_text.lower() in h['text'].lower():
                    out.append((h,depth))
                if h['index'] not in self.collapsed or (self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                    walk(h['children'],depth+1)
        if self.synthetic:
            if not(self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                out.append((None,0))
            if -1 not in self.collapsed or (self.search=='outline' and self.search_text):
                walk(self.doc.roots,1)
        else:
            walk(self.doc.roots,0)
        self.visible=out
        self.selected=min(max(0,self.selected),max(0,len(out)-1))
        return out

    def heading(self):
        self.nodes()
        return self.visible[self.selected][0] if self.visible else None

    def body(self):
        h=self.heading()
        if h is None:
            self.view_title='(Document)' if self.synthetic else 'Content'
            return self.doc.source
        self.view_title=h['text']
        # Sections are addressed by their displayed title in the navigator.
        first=next((v for v in self.doc.headings if v['text']==h['text']),h)
        return first['content']

    def render_content(self,width):
        body=self.body()
        self.elements=[]
        if self.raw:
            self.view=['{:4} │ {}'.format(i+1,line) for i,line in enumerate(body.splitlines())]
            return
        reader=BlockReader(body)
        out=[]

def read_keys(fd):
    raw=os.read(fd,1024)
    if raw.startswith(b'\x1b') and len(raw)==1:
        if select.select([fd],[],[],0.035)[0]:
            raw+=os.read(fd,1024)
    seqs={b'\x1b[A':'UP',b'\x1b[B':'DOWN',b'\x1b[C':'RIGHT',b'\x1b[D':'LEFT',b'\x1b[5~':'PAGEUP',b'\x1b[6~':'PAGEDOWN',b'\x1b[Z':'BACKTAB',b'\x1b[H':'HOME',b'\x1b[F':'END',b'\x1bOH':'HOME',b'\x1bOF':'END'}
    chars={'\r':'ENTER','\n':'ENTER','\t':'TAB','\x7f':'BACKSPACE','\x08':'BACKSPACE','\x1b':'ESC','\x03':'CTRL_C','\x15':'CTRL_U','\x04':'CTRL_D','\x0e':'CTRL_N','\x10':'CTRL_P'}
    out=[]
    while raw:
        found=False
        for seq,key in seqs.items():
            if raw.startswith(seq):
                out.append(key);raw=raw[len(seq):];found=True;break
        if found:continue
        if raw.startswith(b'\x1b[<'):
            m=re.match(rb'\x1b\[<[^mM]*[mM]',raw)
            if m:raw=raw[len(m.group(0)):];continue
        count=1
        while count<=min(4,len(raw)):
            try:
                c=raw[:count].decode('utf-8')
                if len(c)==1:break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:pass
            count+=1
        if count>min(4,len(raw)):
            raw=raw[1:];continue
        out.append(chars.get(c,c))
        raw=raw[count:]
    return out

        termios.tcsetattr(fd,termios.TCSADRAIN,old)
        os.close(fd)

        self.assertEqual(self.query('[1,2,3] | all(. > 2)'),False)
        self.assertEqual(self.query('1+2*3'),7.)
        self.assertEqual(self.query('null // "fallback"'),'fallback')

    def test_json_export(self):
        content='# Title\n\nText **bold**.\n\n## Child\nEnd.\n'
        data=json.loads(self.run_cli('-l','-o','json',data=content).stdout)['document']
        self.assertEqual(data['metadata'],{'source':None,'headingCount':2,'maxDepth':2,'wordCount':7})
        s=data['sections'][0]
        self.assertEqual(s['position'],{'line':2,'offset':8})
        self.assertEqual(s['content']['raw'],'Text **bold**.')
        self.assertEqual(s['content']['blocks'][0],{'type':'paragraph','content':'Text bold.','inline':[{'type':'text','value':'Text '},{'type':'strong','value':'bold'},{'type':'text','value':'.'}]})
        self.assertEqual(s['children'][0]['title'],'Child')

    def test_formats(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-q','.h2','--query-output','plain').stdout,'## Alpha\n## Beta\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-q','.h2','--query-output','tree').stdout,'├──## Alpha\n└──## Beta\n\n')
        r=self.run_cli('-q','.h2','--query-output','jsonl')
        self.assertEqual(len(r.stdout.splitlines()),2)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-q','[.img]','--query-output','plain').stdout,'\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-q','.img','--query-output','json').stdout,'')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-q','[.h] | count','--query-output','json').stdout,'5.0\n')

    def test_errors(self):
        checks=[('-q','.h | unknown_function'),('-q','.missing'),('-q','1/0'),('-q','.h |'),('-q','')]
        for args in checks:
            r=self.run_cli(*args)
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode,1)
            self.assertEqual(r.stdout,'')
            self.assertTrue(r.stderr.startswith('error: '))
        r=self.run_cli('-q','.h','--query-output','jsonp')
        self.assertEqual((r.returncode,r.stderr),(1,'Error: Unknown output format: jsonp\n'))
        r=self.run_cli('-l','-o','tree')
        self.assertEqual((r.returncode,r.stderr),(1,'Use --tree for tree output\n'))

    def test_input_rules(self):

        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-l',data='#no-space\n').stdout,'')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-l',data='```\n# code\n```\n').stdout,'')

            self.assertEqual(r.returncode,1)

        r=subprocess.run([str(EXEC),'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True)

        r=subprocess.run([str(EXEC),'--query-help'],capture_output=True,text=True)

        self.assertIn('COLLECTION FUNCTIONS',r.stdout)
